battle.name: 劉邦起兵反抗秦朝
battle.brief: 秦二世元年，泗水亭長劉邦在沛縣響應陳勝、吳廣的大澤鄉舉事，集壯士數百人夜襲縣城，殺縣令而自號沛公，轉戰陳留、芒砀，終由南陽、峣關一路入關。此役兵無大械，投石機這類配重投射器只是攻城器械之一；真正決定勝負的是弩機、雲梯與糧道，漢元年十月沛公受子嬰之降，秦朝遂亡。

kit.name: 投石機
kit.history: 把絞盤的勢能換成一塊石頭。攻城從此有了可以計算的破壞力。

countries: 起義爆發時，秦朝仍以郡縣體制統治天下：皇帝之下設丞相、太尉、廷尉與九卿，地方置郡守、縣令，軍隊則由郡縣臨時徵發的材官、騎士與車兵，加上關中常備的郡兵與刑徒部隊組成。秦廷在秦始皇死後迅速失序，二世胡亥寵信趙高，誅諸兄十二人及公主殉葬，郡縣守令各自求保，既無統一決策，也沒有可靠命令下達。泗水郡一帶，戍卒與刑徒按律年年徵發，縣令只求不出事，郡兵一旦接到追討的命令便倉促出動。反秦一方起初是各自為政的游兵：陳勝、吳廣在大澤鄉舉事，攻陳縣之後建號張楚；項梁、項羽起於吳中，迎立楚懷王孫心為楚王；趙、齊、燕、魏各自復國，沛公劉邦在沛縣聚眾，與秦廷構成對立的兩極。聯軍雖以楚王為盟主，各路兵馬卻互不隸屬，糧秣自籌，遇強敵便各自退守，器械與指揮都極度分散。
countriesEn: When the revolt broke out, the Qin dynasty still governed the empire through the commandery and county system: under the emperor stood the three senior ministers, the chancellor, the grand commandant and the censor, together with the Nine Offices, while the provinces were run by commandery governors and the counties by magistrates, and the troops were drawn from the craftsmen-infantry, cavalry and chariotry levied on order by the commanderies, supplemented by the garrison units of the Guanzhong heartland and by penal labourers turned into soldiers. After the First Emperor's death the court fell apart quickly: the Second Emperor, Hu Hai, favoured Zhao Gao, executed twelve of his own brothers and had princesses buried with the dead, and commandery governors and magistrates, each answerable only for his own survival, received no coordinated decisions and no trustworthy orders. In the Sishui commandery, conscripted soldiers and penal labourers were called up year after year, the magistrate of Pei cared only that nothing go wrong, and the county troops marched out in a hurry whenever an order to hunt the rebels arrived. The other side began as scattered bands of armed men: Chen Sheng and Wu Guang rose at Daze Village, took the city of Chen and proclaimed the state of Zhangchu; Xiang Liang and Xiang Yu rose in the Wu region and installed King Huai's grandson Xin as King of Chu; Zhao, Qi, Yan and Wei each restored themselves, while Liu Bang, the Lord of Pei, gathered a following in Pei County. The coalition nominally obeyed the King of Chu, yet no contingent was subordinate to another, each raising its own grain, each withdrawing before a stronger enemy: the distribution of men, engines of war and command was extremely fragmented.
people: 沛公劉邦本為沛縣泗水亭長，秦廷徵發卒役時，他曾以亭長率領刑徒、徒卒赴咸陽，途中與同鄉樊噲、曹參、周勃、盧綰、蕭何結下生死之交。起義時他憑鄉里威信聚壯士數百人，乘夜襲取縣城，縣令驚而守城，兵敗之後劉邦得眾為沛公。陳留一役失利，縣中父老協助他夜里縋城而出，步行返回芒、砀之間棲身，兵不滿千，靠游擊與郡兵周旋。薛地遇張良，良以圯橋受書、博浪沙擊秦的舊事為他謀劃，勸他迎立楚懷王孫心以借名分。蕭何留縣收兵、曹參協助徵集，後來更從關中追運糧草；周勃守關中，樊噲、夏侯嬰為先鋒衝陣。敵方則是二世胡亥、趙高與將軍章邯；章邯奉命將刑徒十萬往討張楚，於戲水擊破楚軍，陳勝、吳廣隨即在內部傾軋中敗亡。前207年冬，楚軍於巨鹿全殲秦軍主將王離所部、斬副將蘇角，項羽隨即坑秦軍降卒二十餘萬於新安。
peopleEn: Liu Bang, the Lord of Pei, was by birth the commandant of the Sishui post at Pei County. When the Qin court conscripted labour, he marched the penal labourers and other conscripts as far as Xianyang, and on that road he formed bonds of life and death with his fellow townsmen Fan Kuai, Cao Shen, Zhou Bo, Lu Wan and Xiao He. When the rising began he relied on his standing among the villagers to gather several hundred able men, seized the walled town by night, and after the magistrate raised a force and lost, took command of the crowd as the Lord of Pei. He was checked at Chenliu, and the old men of the town helped him rope himself down the wall by night and walk back to Mang and Dang, where he sheltered in the marshes with a force of less than a thousand, raiding the county troops and avoiding their main effort. At Xue he met Zhang Liang, who used the precedents of the stone bridge at Yiqiao and the thrown dagger at Bolangsha to counsel him, and urged him to install King Huai's grandson Xin so as to borrow the authority of Chu. Xiao He stayed behind to gather the county soldiers, Cao Shen helped with the levy, and later they hauled grain out of Guanzhong; Zhou Bo guarded Guanzhong while Fan Kuai and Xiahou Ying led the vanguard. On the other side stood the Second Emperor Hu Hai, Zhao Gao and the general Zhang Han, who was sent with a hundred thousand penal labourers against Zhangchu and beat the Chu forces at Xishui; Chen Sheng and Wu Guang were destroyed soon afterwards in their own internal feuding. In the winter of 207 BC the Chu army annihilated the main Qin force under Wang Li at Julu and killed the deputy general Su Jiao; Xiang Yu then buried over two hundred thousand surrendered Qin soldiers at Xin'an.
kits: 卡面這件投石機是配重式投射器，屬攻城器械而非野戰兵器：它把絞盤或配重儲存的勢能換成石彈，用來砸壞城牆、屋頂、弩樓與城內建築，射程遠過弓弩，卻射速低、精度差，必須先在城下列好固定基座，運轉時要整組人馬配合。起義初期，沛公軍不過數百人，沒有攻城的重器，能倚賴的只有刀、戟、弓、弩與鄉里徵集的矛兵，因此陳留失利後只能退入山澤游擊；真正大量使用投射砲與雲梯的，是秦軍與後來接管全局的諸侯聯軍。《墨子》公輸、備穴、守城諸篇所記的縣石、連弩車、望樓，說明前四至前三世紀的攻防器械已相當齊備：秦軍攻城以雲梯、望樓壓制城頭，防守一方則以發石、連弩、煙燒反制。戰國以來弩機傳入秦軍，銅機關弩與預儲機括使單兵也能反覆射擊，機括的張力與耐用成為守城的第一道牆。反秦各方在武器上並無壓倒性優勢，秦朝之亡並非器械落後，而是政治崩解之後，郡兵與器械同時失去統一指揮。
kitsEn: The onager on this card is a counterweight traction engine: it is siege equipment rather than a field arm. It converts the stored energy of a windlass or a suspended weight into a stone shot, used to smash walls, roofs, timber galleries and the buildings of a town. Its range far exceeds that of any bow, but its rate of fire is slow, its accuracy poor, it needs a fixed bed laid down in front of the target, and it has to be worked by a whole team of men. In the first weeks of the rising the Lord of Pei had a few hundred men, no heavy engines at all, and could rely on nothing beyond swords, halberds, bows, crossbows and the spears of village levies; that is why after the reverse at Chenliu the force could only fall back into the hills and fight a guerrilla war. The armies that really used massed stone-throwers and siege ladders were the Qin forces and the coalition that later took over the war. The Mozi chapters on Gongshu, on concealed defences and on the defence of walled towns record suspended stones, repeating crossbow carts and watch-towers, showing that offensive and defensive machinery was already highly developed between the fourth and third centuries BC: the Qin attacked with ladders and observation towers to dominate the walls, and the defenders answered with stone-throwers, crossbow volleys and fire against the ladder crews. The crossbow trigger mechanism had entered Qin service during the Warring States, and the bronze mechanisms with stored power let a single soldier shoot repeatedly; the tension and durability of that mechanism was the first wall a garrison had. The rebels held no decisive edge in weapons. Qin did not fall because its engineering was obsolete, but because once the political structure broke, the county troops and the engines of war alike lost any unified command.
tactics: 起義的第一個戰法是奇襲：集壯士於夜間開城、破門、斬首奪旗，趕在郡兵反應之前把縣城變成營壘，沛縣之役即依此得手，也讓楚地各縣聞風響應。第二個戰法是游擊：陳留受挫之後，隊伍退入芒、砀一帶山林澤藪，避開秦軍的進攻鋒頭，待郡兵分兵搜索、糧秣不接時再出擊秦軍側後。楚軍在巨鹿把這一套推到極致：項羽渡河之後破釜沉舟，示無退路，選夜襲營而不與秦軍正面爭鋒，先亂其陣腳，再以全線兵力掩殺，秦軍主力因此崩解。攻城方高度依賴器械與糧道，雲梯集中於城牆一隅強行攀附，望樓居高臨下遠射，守方以發石、連弩、焚燒梯體應對；秦軍的糧道沿泗水、睢水、汝水與關中漕運，一旦被斷，十日上下即難以支持。攻守雙方在雲梯、投石、弩三者的配比與射界協調上決定勝負，而聯軍各部互不統一指揮，器械調度與糧秣分配始終是弱點。
tacticsEn: The first method of the rising was the surprise attack: able men were concentrated at night, the gate forced, the wall breached, the enemy leaders taken and the flags seized, so that the county town became a camp before the district troops could react. That is how Pei fell, and it was the news of it that set the counties of Chu off in turn. The second method was the guerrilla raid. After the reverse at Chenliu the troops withdrew into the hills and marshes of Mang and Dang, avoided the head of the Qin advance, and waited until the county troops were spread out on the hunt and their food ran short before falling on their rear. The Chu army took this to its extreme at Julu: after fording the river Xiang Yu broke his cauldrons and sank his boats to show there was no retreat, chose to assault by night instead of fighting the Qin army in the open, threw the Qin formations into confusion first and then swept the whole line forward, and the Qin main force collapsed. The attacker depended heavily on machinery and on the grain road. Ladders were massed against a single section of wall, observation towers were raised to shoot down into the town, and the defenders answered with stone-throwers, crossbow volleys and fire against the ladder crews. The Qin supply line ran by the Sishui, the Sui and the Ru rivers and by the canal transport from Guanzhong; once cut, it could not be held for more than about ten days. What decided the fights was the balance between ladders, stone throwers and crossbows and the coordination of their fields of fire, and the coalition's failure to keep a single command meant that the allocation of engines and of grain remained its permanent weakness.
data: 有根據可用的數字並不多，且多有誇大。陳勝、吳廣所部為九百名被徵發的戍卒，因雨阻道而誤期，按秦律當斬，遂起事於大澤鄉，攻陳縣之後建號張楚；其後張楚一度遣將徇地，所記兵眾與據地數在史書中明顯放大，參考時須打折。劉邦聚眾為數百人，取沛縣後收縣卒，兵力仍在千餘上下；巨鹿之戰，項羽渡河的楚兵約八千餘人，擊潰的秦軍主力則被記為數十萬，兩數皆出自敵我雙方的誇張陳述，實際當以倍數計。器械方面，羅馬的野戰營通常配置三十座左右的投射砲與數十座輕型扭力弩；前292年羅得島圍城戰中，希臘人以配重式巨砲拋出重逾一噸半的石彈，射程遠出任何弓弩。弩的有效射程約在一百五十至三百米之間，齊射可及城頭。關於年表，《史記》《漢書》用秦曆，歲首在十月，故秦二世元年九月換算公曆已是前208年9月，通行年表或繫於前209年，兩種紀年並見於世，本篇從任務所給編年。
dataEn: Few figures survive that can be relied upon, and most of them are exaggerated. Chen Sheng and Wu Guang led nine hundred conscripted soldiers; heavy rain blocked the road and made them miss their reporting date, and under Qin law that was punishable by death, so they rose at Daze Village, took the city of Chen and proclaimed the state of Zhangchu. The armies and the number of counties that Zhangchu's envoys are later said to have brought under its control are plainly inflated in the histories and must be discounted. Liu Bang gathered several hundred men, took Pei and enrolled the county soldiers, and his force stayed in the low thousands. At Julu, Xiang Yu forded the river with about eight thousand Chu troops against a Qin main force recorded as several hundred thousand; both numbers are hostile exaggerations and the real figures should be given as fractions of them. As for machinery, a Roman field camp was normally supplied with around thirty stone-throwers and a number of light torsion bolt engines; in the siege of Rhodes in 292 BC the Greeks threw stones of more than a tonne and a half with counterweight engines whose range far exceeded any bow. A crossbow's effective range lay roughly between one hundred fifty and three hundred metres, enough for massed volleys to reach the top of a wall. On the chronology, the Shiji and the Hanshu use the Qin calendar, whose year began in the tenth month, so the ninth month of the Second Emperor's first year converts to September 208 BC in the modern reckoning; popular tables often place it in 209 BC. Both dates are found in the sources, and this account follows the chronology given with the assignment.
cause: 秦亡並非出於一場偶發的舉事，而是六國餘緒、徭役兵役、刑罰與政治失序四股力量交纏的結果。統治全國不過十餘年的秦朝，郡縣之上的官吏既無世襲根基，也無容身退路，於是上行下效，一切以保命為先；驪山刑徒的數十萬、關中與六國的常年徵發，使田園荒廢、里巷疲敝。大澤鄉一場大雨阻斷道路，九百名戍卒因誤期而面臨集體斬首，陳勝、吳廣在途中說出的那句「王侯將相寧有種乎」，把被徵發者的怨恨變成了可否認的號召。張良以韓國亡國之後的身份在博浪沙狙擊秦始皇、又在沛縣策動，是另一條線索：六國舊族的報復心願與民間的求生衝動在此合流。引信仍在中央：二世誅諸兄十二人及公主殉葬，趙高隱瞞沙丘之謀而專斷朝政，郡縣守令既得不到可信的命令，也不敢擅自出兵勤王，於是沛縣一響，各城各自求全，鎮壓力量逐級瓦解。
causeEn: Qin did not fall because of some accidental rising, but because four forces closed upon one another: the surviving memory of the six conquered states, the burden of corvée and conscription, the severity of the penal code, and the political disorder of the court. A dynasty that had ruled the whole realm for little more than a decade gave its governors and magistrates no hereditary base and no way to save themselves, so the whole hierarchy served self-preservation; the tens of thousands of penal labourers at the Lishan works and the annual levies in Guanzhong and across the old six states left fields untended and villages exhausted. At Daze Village a heavy rain blocked the road, and nine hundred conscripts who had missed their reporting date faced collective execution; the words Chen Sheng and Wu Guang spoke on that road turned the resentment of the levied into a slogan no authority could unsay. Zhang Liang, a descendant of the destroyed state of Han who had thrown a dagger at the First Emperor at Bolangsha and later turned up at Pei to stir the town, was a second thread: the revenge of the old aristocracy and the survival impulse of common people met in the same rising. The fuse still burned at the centre. The Second Emperor killed twelve of his brothers and buried the princesses with the dead; Zhao Gao concealed the affair at the tomb mound and monopolised the court; the governors and magistrates of the commanderies could neither obtain a credible order nor dare to send troops to the capital on their own initiative. So when Pei rose, every city thought only of saving itself, and the force that was meant to suppress the rebellion came apart link by link.
impact: 秦朝覆亡的直接後果，是統一的帝國第一次被起義推翻：前206年十月沛公入關，太子嬰素車白馬出降於軻道，約法三章，封存秦府庫，諸吏案堵如故，秦地的生產與律令秩序短期內延續下來。制度上，郡縣、戶籍、軍功爵與徵發體系並未隨秦亡而廢，漢承秦制，郡國並行之下，縣以下仍靠秦式的編戶齊民運作。社會上，軍功授爵打開了上升通道，公乘以下皆有爵可升，平民出身的樊噲、周勃、夏侯嬰，以及布衣的韓信、張良分居將帥之位，六國舊族反而多數淪為輸賦與經商的負擔者。戰爭的破壞極大：關中與中原的糧食生產幾近停擺，陳留、潁陽一線的城邑屢遭攻掠，巨鹿與新安兩役，坑降卒二十餘萬與強行驅逼，使大批秦軍散兵淪為流民與盜匪，漢廷其後不得不以輸轉、復仇與徙置豪強的方式收拾殘局。技術層面，秦軍的弩機、雲梯、縣石之屬隨戰亂散入關中與四方郡縣，漢軍之後的器械譜系，多能在此役中找到源頭。
impactEn: The direct consequence of Qin's collapse was that a unified empire was overturned for the first time by an insurrection. In October 206 BC the Lord of Pei entered the passes; the Crown Prince Ying came out in a plain carriage with white horses and surrendered at Kedao. Three simple rules were proclaimed, the Qin treasuries were sealed, the officials left in charge and the registers untouched, and for a time the production and legal order of the Qin lands carried on. Institutionally the commanderies, the household registers, the system of military merit ranks and the levy system did not die with the dynasty: the Han inherited the Qin framework, and under the parallel of commanderies and feudatories the counties below were still run on the Qin model of registered households. Socially, reward by military merit opened a path upward: a rank of the commonest grade could still be earned, and men of no birth such as Fan Kuai, Zhou Bo and Xiahou Ying, and commoners such as Han Xin and Zhang Liang, took their places among generals and ministers, while most of the old aristocratic families of the six states were reduced to payers of taxes and traders. The destruction of the war was immense. Grain production in Guanzhong and the central plain came close to stopping; towns along the Chenliu and Yingyang lines were repeatedly stormed; and at Julu and Xin'an, with more than two hundred thousand surrendered men buried and the prisoners driven off in a body, great numbers of disbanded Qin soldiers became refugees and brigands, so that the Han court afterwards had to tidy up through convoys, reprisals and the removal of powerful households. On the technical side the Qin crossbow mechanisms, siege ladders and stone-throwers scattered with the fighting into Guanzhong and the commanderies, and the later Han inventory of siege equipment can largely be traced back to this campaign.
result: 起義的結果分三層。就秦朝而言，主力在巨鹿被楚軍擊潰，王離被虜、蘇角被斬，章邯率二十萬眾在廢丘投降後被坑於新安；前206年十月子嬰降於沛公，秦朝就此終結，前後約十五年的帝國壽命告終。就反秦聯盟而言，勝利的果實沒有落在陳勝、吳廣或楚懷王孫心手上：沛公先入關中受降封王，聯軍主力其後才到，項羽以戰功居首，殺楚懷王孫心而自立，改封諸侯王，於是天下秩序重新劃分，關中歸漢，楚地歸楚，劉邦被封漢王而居巴蜀漢中。就長局而言，楚漢對峙由此開始：前206年八月，項羽分兵攻漢，漢王聽張良之計退保漢中；前205年韓信拜大將，率主力出漢中東向，戰略重心由此轉入決戰。對卡面這件投石機而言，這場戰爭的意義不在它如何攻城——它幾乎沒有在沛縣、陳留一線真正上過陣——而在它把前二世紀地中海與東亞同時出現的攻城機械化壓力，留在了下一個四百年中國軍事的底層。
resultEn: The outcome of the rising can be read on three levels. As to Qin, the main force was destroyed by the Chu army at Julu, with Wang Li taken prisoner and Su Jiao killed; Zhang Han surrendered with two hundred thousand men at Feiqiu and they were buried at Xin'an; in October 206 BC the Crown Prince Ying surrendered to the Lord of Pei, and the dynasty ended, closing a life of roughly fifteen years. As to the anti-Qin coalition, the fruits of victory did not fall to Chen Sheng, Wu Guang or to King Huai's grandson: the Lord of Pei entered the passes first and took the surrender and a royal title, while the main body of the coalition arrived only afterwards. Xiang Yu, first in the order of merit, killed King Huai's grandson, established himself, and parceled out the realm as a patchwork of kings, so that the order of the world was redrawn, with Guanzhong given to Han and Chu territory to Chu, and Liu Bang made King of Han and settled in Bashu and Hanzhong. As to the long run, the Chu-Han confrontation began here: in the eighth month of 206 BC Xiang Yu sent troops against Han, and the King of Han, following Zhang Liang's advice, withdrew to Hanzhong; in 205 BC Han Xin was made great general and led the main force out of Hanzhong toward the east, shifting the centre of the war into decisive battle. For the onager on this card, the meaning of this war lies not in how it attacked towns, for it hardly ever saw action on the Pei-Chenliu line, but in the fact that the mechanical pressure on fortifications, which appeared in the Mediterranean and in East Asia alike during the second century BC, was carried forward into the bedrock of Chinese warfare for the four hundred years that followed.
